tasks.analysis: Public health is a multidisciplinary field concerned with preventing disease, prolonging life, and promoting health through organized efforts and informed choices. It includes strategies such as health education, vaccination programs, and policies aimed at ensuring safe environments. Public health professionals work to identify health disparities.
